subject.title: fix(agents): keep auto-compaction on the live session model (#95696)

question: Should compaction follow the pending live-session provider/model/auth profile selection when a live switch cannot restart the current attempt, or should maintainers require a full live multi-provider compaction capture before merge?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-backed, but it deliberately changes auth-provider routing during compaction, which is compatibility-sensitive maintainer territory.

options.title: Accept focused routing fix
options.body: Land after normal maintainer review accepts that compaction should follow the pending live selection and drop stale cross-provider auth profiles.

options.title: Require live multi-provider proof
options.body: Ask for a timeout or overflow compaction capture with real provider credentials before merge if source-level and terminal proof are not enough.

recommendation.title: Accept focused routing fix
recommendation.body: Land after normal maintainer review accepts that compaction should follow the pending live selection and drop stale cross-provider auth profiles.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on live model switch semantics that this compaction fix consumes.
